sqlTemplate:
SELECT 'vl', COUNT(s.status)
FROM sync_task s
         INNER JOIN sync_task_type st ON s.sync_task_type = st.sync_task_type_id
WHERE st.uuid = 'f9b2fa5d-5d37-4fd9-b20a-a0cab664f520'
  AND s.status_code IN (200, 201)
  AND s.date_created >=:startDate and s.date_created <= :endDate
  AND s.voided = 0;
